params.name: From
params.description: A calling party. Could be an E.164 number, a SIP URI, or a Twilio Client registered name.

params.name: To
params.description: A called party. Could be an E.164 number, a SIP URI, or a Twilio Client registered name.

params.name: FromCarrier
params.description: An origination carrier.

params.name: ToCarrier
params.description: A destination carrier.

params.name: FromCountryCode
params.description: A source country code based on phone number in From.

params.name: ToCountryCode
params.description: A destination country code. Based on phone number in To.

params.name: Branded
params.description: A boolean flag indicating whether or not the calls were branded using Twilio Branded Calls.

params.name: VerifiedCaller
params.description: A boolean flag indicating whether or not the caller was verified using SHAKEN/STIR.

params.name: HasTag
params.description: A boolean flag indicating the presence of one or more [Voice Insights Call Tags](https://www.twilio.com/docs/voice/voice-insights/api/call/details-call-tags).

params.name: StartTime
params.description: A Start time of the calls. xm (x minutes), xh (x hours), xd (x days), 1w, 30m, 3d, 4w or datetime-ISO. Defaults to 4h.

params.name: EndTime
params.description: An End Time of the calls. xm (x minutes), xh (x hours), xd (x days), 1w, 30m, 3d, 4w or datetime-ISO. Defaults to 0m.

params.name: CallType
params.description: A Call Type of the calls. One of `carrier`, `sip`, `trunking` or `client`.

params.name: CallState
params.description: A Call State of the calls. One of `ringing`, `completed`, `busy`, `fail`, `noanswer`, `canceled`, `answered`, `undialed`.

params.name: Direction
params.description: A Direction of the calls. One of `outbound_api`, `outbound_dial`, `inbound`, `trunking_originating`, `trunking_terminating`.

params.name: ProcessingState
params.description: A Processing State of the Call Summaries. One of `completed`, `partial` or `all`.

params.name: SortBy
params.description: A Sort By criterion for the returned list of Call Summaries. One of `start_time` or `end_time`.

params.name: Subaccount
params.description: A unique SID identifier of a Subaccount.

params.name: AbnormalSession
params.description: A boolean flag indicating an abnormal session where the last SIP response was not 200 OK.

params.name: AnsweredBy
params.description: An Answered By value for the calls based on `Answering Machine Detection (AMD)`. One of `unknown`, `machine_start`, `machine_end_beep`, `machine_end_silence`, `machine_end_other`, `human` or `fax`.

params.name: AnsweredByAnnotation
params.description: Either machine or human.

params.name: ConnectivityIssueAnnotation
params.description: A Connectivity Issue with the calls. One of `no_connectivity_issue`, `invalid_number`, `caller_id`, `dropped_call`, or `number_reachability`.

params.name: QualityIssueAnnotation
params.description: A subjective Quality Issue with the calls. One of `no_quality_issue`, `low_volume`, `choppy_robotic`, `echo`, `dtmf`, `latency`, `owa`, `static_noise`.

params.name: SpamAnnotation
params.description: A boolean flag indicating spam calls.

params.name: CallScoreAnnotation
params.description: A Call Score of the calls. Use a range of 1-5 to indicate the call experience score, with the following mapping as a reference for the rated call [5: Excellent, 4: Good, 3 : Fair, 2 : Poor, 1: Bad].

params.name: PageSize
params.description: How many resources to return in each list page. The default is 50, and the maximum is 1000.

params.name: Page
params.description: The page index. This value is simply for client state.

params.name: PageToken
params.description: The page token. This is provided by the API.

params.name: IsoCountry
params.description: The [ISO country code](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/ISO_3166-1_alpha-2) of the origin-based voice pricing information to fetch.

params.name: DestinationNumber
params.description: The destination phone number, in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format, for which to fetch the origin-based voice pricing information. E.164 format consists of a + followed by the country code and subscriber number.

params.name: OriginationNumber
params.description: The origination phone number, in [E.164](https://www.twilio.com/docs/glossary/what-e164) format, for which to fetch the origin-based voice pricing information. E.164 format consists of a + followed by the country code and subscriber number.
